route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/s81sl_lepenh_diag/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/s81sl_lepenh_diag/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/s81sl_lepenh_diag --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_s81sl_slice_lepe_nh_x_lp --macro-view physical/ref_tile/s81sl_lepenh_diag/standin_views/dsfd_coll_lane_e --macro-view physical/ref_tile/s81sl_lepenh_diag/standin_views/ot_s81sl_lep_nh --macro-view physical/ref_tile/s81sl_lepenh_diag/standin_views/ot_s81sl_slice > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

hold_merge: stand-in children: diagnostic only, never route or bind

Children are slice_standin.py abstracts (STANDIN_NOT_A_VIEW): slice 1252.8 x 5702.4 (PL-SLICE draft), lep_nh 475.2 sq (s81sl_lepnh pin plan), lane_e = closed lane_w plan mirrored.
